title: Electric Eye Oracle
description: A large glass plasma globe sits on a wooden table, containing two glowing red eyeballs connected by bright yellow electrical arcs and pink plasma tendrils. A human finger points toward the smaller floating eyeball from the right side of the frame.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy painting of a large antique plasma globe on a wooden table, containing two glowing red eyeballs connected by intense yellow electrical arcs and pink plasma tendrils. A human finger points at the smaller floating eyeball from the right. Inside the glass, a haunted gothic cityscape is faintly visible. Dramatic lighting, smoky background, moody and mysterious atmosphere.
